'''Dref Voltin''' was a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] working for [[Hypermedia Galactic News Service]]. Voltin reported on the [[Battle of Sluis Van]], and the arrest of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] on charges of [[Treason/Legends|treason]].
